question_summary: Direction needed on location/layout of the cast-in anchor bolt group at Gridline E/9 due to conflict between Foundation Plan S-101 and Sheet S-301, and whether to revise per S-301 or await a revised sheet to proceed with steel fabrication.
proposed_solution: Revise the cast-in anchor bolt group per Sheet S-301 and coordinate final dimensions with affected trades before fabrication.
deadline_text: We need this resolved before the next steel erection mobilization.
routing_rationale: The SER must resolve conflicting structural documents and provide final direction on anchor bolt placement impacting foundations and steel.
